expo.name: Dagitab
expo.//: slug must stay WiseWatt: it is fixed at EAS project creation and cannot be renamed. Changing it orphans the project ID, build history, and Android keystore. Users never see the slug. The package stays com.magat_nokia.WattWise for the same reason - changing it makes Android treat the rebrand as a different app, so testers could not upgrade.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Dagitab uses the camera to scan the QR code on your ESP32 device so it can be linked to your account.
